content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Software stripe

Stripe is a payment gateway that operates in 46 countries, but it excludes many others, including Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan. Gumroad is a digital marketplace that allows creators to sell their products, but it also has restrictions on countries and currencies. PayPal is a payment processor that's widely used, but its suspension policies are notoriously harsh. Each of these options has its own set of limitations and drawbacks, but they're often the only choices available to digital creators. That's where sovereign commerce infrastructure comes in – a permanent, base-layer solution that gives you full ownership and control over your digital store.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and Gumroad both have rules in place for restricted countries, but they're often vague and open to interpretation. PayPal's policies are even more restrictive, and suspension can lead to lost funds for up to 180 days. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, on the other hand, doesn't rely on these third-party platforms at all. By designing, documenting, and deploying your own digital store with COREMERCH, you're not subject to the same rules and restrictions. You own your infrastructure, and you're free to operate as you see fit.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe's payment processing fees range from 2.9% + 30¢ per transaction, while Gumroad charges 3.5% + 30¢ per transaction. PayPal's fees vary depending on the type of account you have, but they can be as high as 4.4% + 0.30¢ per transaction. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, on the other hand, has a flat fee of 0.5% for NOWPayments, and you can choose your own payment network for even lower fees. With COREMERCH, you're in control of your costs and your payment speed.
You don't have to rely on Stripe or Gumroad to sell your digital products – sovereign commerce infrastructure is here to change everything.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Stripe, Gumroad, and PayPal all have their own systems for handling payments and delivering products, but they can be clunky and unreliable. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, on the other hand, allows you to automate your entire process with Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script. You can customize your delivery process to fit your needs, and you own the entire infrastructure from start to finish. With COREMERCH, you're not limited by the capabilities of third-party platforms.

This includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, all deployed in 48 hours with 5 products loaded and SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured. Whether you're in Nigeria, Ghana, or Pakistan, or any other restricted country, COREMERCH has got you covered.
